notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block and kill Bladewing.
You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Bladewing.
Bladewing triggers, creating at least three 2/2 Zombie Knight creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Zombie Knights, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The Zombie Knights die, triggering Pitiless Plunderer twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
